name: Das Telefonbuch (DTM Deutsche Tele Medien)

search.notes: Path pattern returned a results page for a fake name. Reverse search only finds people who agreed to Inverssuche. Results can also include social network and web hits.

steps: Email DTM Deutsche Tele Medien GmbH at eintragsservice@dtme.de, or use https://ihr-eintrag.dtme.de/, and ask to delete the private entry or to object to publication and to reverse search (Widerspruch gegen Veröffentlichung und Inverssuche).
Attach a copy of an ID card or passport. Black out everything except name, photo and address, and mark it with the word Kopie.
Or call DTM on 0800 3863 3436, or write to DTM Deutsche Tele Medien GmbH, Wiesenhüttenstraße 18, 60329 Frankfurt am Main.
Alternatively ask the phone provider directly (see de-teilnehmerverzeichnis-widerspruch).
optout.notes: Das Örtliche names DTM as the contact for entry changes, objection to publication and objection to reverse search, so one DTM request should cover both directories. No time is stated.

sources.attribution: Das Örtliche Datenschutz, Widerspruch gegen Inverssuche

verification_note: Das Telefonbuch help page loaded with HTTP 200 on 2026-10-21 and describes deletion through DTM with an ID copy. dtme.de itself refused connections.
